source.name: Lab 2.0: Knowledge Base
source.instructions:
To pass, all checks must pass:

Check 1: chapter5/docs/ folder exists.
Check 2: chapter5/docs/banking_products.txt exists and is non-empty.
Check 3: chapter5/docs/banking_policies.txt exists and is non-empty.
source.guidance:
Check 1 fails if the docs/ folder was not created inside chapter5/. The folder must exist before the files can be added.
Check 2 fails if banking_products.txt is missing from chapter5/docs/ or was saved empty. Check the filename is spelled correctly, it is case-sensitive.
Check 3 fails if banking_policies.txt is missing from chapter5/docs/ or was saved empty. Check the filename is spelled correctly — it is case-sensitive.
